environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from HALOPSA_TENANT and HALOPSA_DOMAIN. Set it only to point at a different host.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client_credentials ID from Configuration → Integrations → Halo PSA API.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: Domain template variable. Defaults to halopsa.com.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_DOMAIN

environmentVariables.description: Sets HALOPSA_OAUTH_SCOPE for the HaloPSA MCP server. Required by the generated client for credential refresh or hand-written auth flow.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_OAUTH_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: Optional. OAuth2 scope (defaults to "all"); set to a narrower scope when your API application requires it
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: Optional. Pre-issued Bearer access token. Overrides the client_credentials flow when set.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint the client-credentials exchange posts to. Leave blank: the CLI derives it from the base URL.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_TOKEN_URL

environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to keep credentials off disk. The token cache becomes a no-op, so the connector mints a fresh token each run instead of writing one to config.toml. Leave blank for the default cached behaviour.
environmentVariables.name: HALOPSA_NO_CONFIG_WRITE
